actions: Read handoff, Brahms Phase 2 findings (STR-01..STR-10) and Stravinsky Phase 2 findings, current .containerignore and Containerfile.

PATCH 1 (STR-07): appended the full credential pattern set to the .containerignore secrets block under the '# Gradle/Maven credential files' comment: gradle.properties, **/gradle.properties, .netrc, **/.netrc, .m2/settings.xml, **/.m2/settings.xml, .ssh/, **/.ssh/, .ssh/id_*, **/.ssh/id_*, .aws/, **/.aws/, **/credentials, **/credentials.*, terraform.tfvars, terraform.tfvars.json, **/terraform.tfvars, **/terraform.tfvars.json, *.pfx, **/*.pfx (exactly as dispatched).

PATCH 2 (STR-08): hardened the existing-builder branch of the account RUN after the uid/gid assertions: (1) usermod --gid 1000 builder 2>/dev/null || true (force primary group to GID 1000, tolerant); (2) usermod --groups builder builder (strip supplementary groups); (3) usermod --lock builder (lock password); (4) assert [ "$(id -G builder)" = "1000" ]; (5) fail closed via ! grep -rq '^builder\b\|^%builder\b' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>/dev/null || { echo ERROR; exit 1; }. Each step has an inline comment.
Applied usermod --lock builder to the ubuntu-rename branch for consistency (its existing usermod -G builder builder already performs the --groups builder strip).

Red-phase micro-verification of the existing-builder branch in isolation (the pinned base ships ubuntu, so the branch is latent in the real build): extracted the exact account RUN block from the Containerfile into account-block.sh (verified with bash -n via WSL), built two micro-test base images from the same pinned base, and ran the block inside each under --network=none.

commit.message: fix(infra): apply phase-2 security patches STR-07/STR-08 (P1-001)

micro_test_negative.observed: exit 1; -x trace: uid/gid asserts -> usermod --gid 1000 -> --groups builder -> --lock -> [ id -G = 1000 ] -> grep finds rule -> ERROR -> exit 1
